title: NIST WebBook: Copper is Cu, molecular weight 63.546 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Copper as Cu, molecular weight 63.546 amu, CAS 7440-50-8.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Copper, CAS Registry Number 7440-50-8, lists molecular formula Cu and molecular weight 63.546 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 62.9295975 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/Cu. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight.
